tagline: Upload in the Preview, and a fuller Office viewer.
subtitle: Agents can upload files to a page, and Word, Excel and slides read better.

cards.title: Agents upload files to a page
cards.text: An agent driving the Preview can upload a file into the page, and the frame shows the file's name.

cards.title: Word as numbered pages
cards.text: Word files show as separate, numbered pages, with a zoom menu for fit width and fit page.

cards.title: Excel and slides
cards.text: Excel keeps column widths, merged cells and fills, and cells copy. A deck presents full screen.

also: The Code tab keeps your last tab
Share tab hover card fits the window
footer: Linux is a beta. Try it and tell us what breaks.
